# Mutation Invasion: All Rewards

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Sep 4, 2024
- 11 min read

Updated: Sep 8, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_deaf242960984d6d89525b743ae1a631~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Rewards for Mutation Invasion Events__

Downloadable and Printable copies can be found __here__.

**Drop Rate Infographic**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3eaa1074fb3e4ce1a46ee0ea5905e698~mv2.jpg)

**Reward Checklist** 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0f24bb53baad44628fb4adbdd9932cb8~mv2.png)

__Rewards__

When participating in mutated events, the rewards you receive depend on the number of Fallout 1st members in the event. Below is a detailed breakdown of the rewards based on whether you complete the event with fewer or more than 3 Fallout 1st members.

__Single Mutation Rewards__

Awarded for completing a Mutated Event with less than 3 Fallout 1st Members present:

- Legendary Scrip: x35
- Treasury Notes: x1
- Mutated Package x1

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_be29014d562d4fe18f3980ef4a19c23a~mv2.jpg)

__Single Mutation FOF Rewards__

Awarded for completing a Mutated Event with 3 or more Fallout 1st Members present.

When an event is successfully completed with 3 or more Fallout 1st members, every participant will receive a Mutated Party Pack instead of the standard Mutated Package.

- Legendary Scrip: x35
- Treasury Notes: x1
- Mutated Party Pack x1

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bf9e6e2678774a50b76e201f17227626~mv2.jpg)

__Item Breakdown__

***Contextual Ammo**

When you open a package, the ammo you receive will match the weapon you're holding, with the exception of the following:

- Syringer Ammo
- Paddle Ball String
- Camera Film
- Flares
- Ultracite Fusion Cores
- Mini Nukes
- Missiles
- If you're using a melee weapon or a weapon without a matching ammo type, you'll receive a randomly selected ammo instead.

***Murmrgh's Mystery Pick**

Murmrgh's Mystery Pick will randomly select a 3-star item from either the weapons or armor categories.

***Rare and Ultra Rare Plans**

All plans will stop dropping once learned, increasing the odds on the remaining plans. However, once a character has learned all the plans available, duplicates will start dropping again at the odds listed on the drop rate infographic at the top of this guide.

***Weapons**

**Boomstick** 

- Two shot - +1 Projectiles +25% Damage -150% Hip-Fire Accuracy +100% Recoil
- Hitman's - +25% Damage While Aiming
- Lightweight - 90% reduced weight
- Missile Launcher

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_19435b16942b41f6b1d614625818cc67~mv2.jpg)

**Longshot** 

- Instigating - +100% Damage Against Targets with Full Health
- Hitman's - +25% Damage While Aiming
- Ghost's - 10% Chance to cause the Player to be Invisible for 2 seconds when Hitting a Target
- Sniper Rifle

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_96eb61c1d7074e95aa396f8ea5ec14b2~mv2.jpg)

**Overkill** 

- Two shot - +1 Projectiles +25% Damage -150% Hip-Fire Accuracy +100% Recoil
- Hitman's - +25% Damage While Aiming
- Lightweight - 90% reduced weight
- Fatman

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e8f2f5fd13184111aa789fc5ce63b7ce~mv2.jpg)

**The Peacemaker** 

- Juggernaut's - Damage Increases up to 25% as Health Increases
- Rapid - +25% Weapon Speed
- Lightweight - 90% reduced weight
- Auto Grenade Launcher

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dcab70694d9545b5ab6d2ff12405dd76~mv2.jpg)

**Slug Buster**

- Anti-Armour - +50% Armor Penetration
- Vital - V.A.T.S. critical shots do +50% damage
- Lightweight - 90% reduced weight
- Plasma Gun

**Fancy Pump Action Shotgun**

- Anti-Armour - +50% Armor Penetration
- Crippling - +50% Limb Damage
- Steadfast - +50 Damage Resistance While Aiming
- Shotgun

**Fancy Single Action Revolver**

- Random 1* Legendary Prefix
- Revolver

Ultra-rare plans and apparel have been fixed and are now dropping correctly.
